text.tspan: Share of people who are undernourished
Share of the population whose daily food intake does not provide enough energy to maintain a normal, active,

tspan.tspan: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (2025)
The FAO reports all values below 2.5% as "<2.5%" due to high uncertainty at very low levels of undernourishment.
